description: Core record types and the common metadata fields they share.

terminology.record: Any persisted typed JSON file in a project workspace (OBJECTIVE, REQUIREMENT, TASK, ARTIFACT, EVIDENCE, ACCEPTANCE, DECISION, RELEASE, DISCOVERY).
terminology.ARTIFACT: A concrete deliverable produced by executing tasks. Distinct from REQUIREMENT (a need), TASK (work) and EVIDENCE (proof). The file name artifact-types.json is historical; this file defines core record types.
terminology.epistemic_status: Separate from lifecycle status. Values: OBJECTIVE (a defined goal/intent), FACT (verified, requires evidence), ASSUMPTION (believed, requires rationale), UNKNOWN (not known, requires rationale).

artifact_types.description: A goal or intent the project exists to achieve.
Requirement, assumption, constraint, risk, idea or unknown.
A concrete deliverable produced by executing tasks.
First-class proof linked to requirements, tasks and artifacts.
Explicit acceptance decision with human authority and evidence.
Recorded decision with context and consequences.
Discovery report separating findings, assumptions, unknowns, constraints and risks.

principle: Do not force every domain-specific artifact into the common core metadata model beyond the shared fields above.
